prompt: Build the V8 phase/packaging carrier with a crankcase block, cylinder guide channels and counterweights: two banks at 45 degrees, four crank phase groups 0/90/180/270, eight piston-and-rod sets on four shared crankpins, and one connected crankshaft. The block is one connected casting with a base plate, two main-bearing webs with journal bores, a top rail, thin cylinder guide channels around the sliders and two head rails carried by outboard columns; the main-bearing fit, the slider-to-guide gaps and the counterweights are measured. All eighteen instances must export separately and must not interfere at the five listed input angles.
notes: Contract v5 (block/bearing/counterweight/guide rung): the frame is a crankcase block with two main-bearing webs, a top rail, one head rail per bank on outboard columns and two thin guide plates per slider whose inner faces sit at +/-10.1 mm from the bank axis (plates centered at +/-10.35 mm).

The measured bearing fit binds the block bore to the crankshaft journals at the two declared stations (whole sampled clearance interval inside 0.4-1.6 mm, axis offset at most 0.3 mm). This is a demonstrator clearance band, not a calibrated manufacturing tolerance, bearing load rating, lubrication or wear model.

Counterweight balance is a geometric vertex-sector measurement on the declared web planes: material beyond 11 mm on the pin side fails, and material opposite the throw must reach at least 12 mm within a 35-degree sector. It is not a mass moment, balance factor, stress or fatigue calculation.

Guide clearance is measured by rays from each slider centre to the nearest block face at the five sampled crank angles: the guide face must lie within 0.15 mm of the declared 10.1 mm inner-face offset and the measured slider-to-guide gap must stay inside 0.2-1.0 mm. It is a sampled radial channel gap, not a continuous bore, ring, roundness, surface finish or wear measurement.
Connectivity is exact edge connectivity of the rendered crank and block parts at 0 degrees; it is not balance, strength, machining or a complete cylinder block.

No cylinder heads with valves, firing order or lubrication are modeled. Only five input angles, mesh-bounds slider centres, 153 pairwise collision checks per angle, two bearing stations, eight web planes and 80 sampled guide rays per angle are covered.
